<p>“It’s getting cold…”</p><p>More than three months had passed since the Baekgwang Construction incident.</p><p>In that time, I’d cleared one A-rank Gate and two B-rank Gates.</p><p>The team the Association had introduced me to was such a dream team that there hadn’t been a single death or injury.</p><p>At the end of the year, the Association announced that they would promote 30 B-rank Hunters to A-rank based on their performance, and there was a minimum requirement to qualify for that promotion.</p><p>Thanks to the Association’s arrangements, I’d met that minimum by clearing one A-rank Gate and two B-rank Gates in a short span of time.</p><p>I was pretty sure my promotion to A-rank was already decided.</p><p>The balance in my bank account had started to exceed two billion won.</p><p>‘…I’ve never had this much money before. I don’t even know how to spend it.’</p><p>I’d pre-ordered a brand-new domestic car that was set to release early next year. Even though it was one of the higher-end sedans, the money in my account showed no signs of decreasing.</p><p>I’d considered investing, but after hearing people around me say, “Why would a Hunter invest? Just clearing one more Gate has a better return,” I gave up on the idea.</p><p>And honestly, they had a point. Clearing a Gate could net hundreds of millions, so fretting over daily percentage fluctuations was a waste of talent.</p><p>The house was quiet. Na-hyeon was in the middle of deciding whether to become a full-time employee at the Association after graduation or end her internship, so she’d been stuck at the Association lately.</p><p>Her internship was supposed to end next week.</p><p>Yu-na’s situation at work had gotten even worse, so she had more days off, and on those days, she seemed to be looking for a new job.</p><p>‘…Why is she even looking for a job?’</p><p>I’d told her not to worry about work since I was making enough money for both of us, but Yu-na seemed to feel guilty and kept trying to earn her own. I was still trying to talk her out of it.</p><p>And in three days, it would be the long-awaited College Scholastic Ability Test—the day that would decide the fate of our household’s retaker.</p><p>Even with Yu-na, me, and Yoon Ji-hyeon all at home, the house was eerily silent.</p><p>We weren’t doing anything that could make noise, not even turning on the TV.</p><p>‘Being a retaker really is like holding office…’</p><p>Even watching a single video required earphones, which was a hassle, but I only had to endure it for three more days.</p><p>***</p><p>The house was filled with laughter. The test was over, and Na-hyeon’s internship had ended, so she’d moved her things out of the dorm yesterday and come back home.</p><p>Yoon Ji-hyeon must have done well on the test because she’d been beaming ever since she came home and graded her own answers.</p><p>Na-hyeon was also always smiling, saying she thought she’d be hired as a full-time employee at the Association.</p><p>‘Hmm… It’s nice to have the whole family together after so long.’</p><p>Seong Yu-na must be in a good mood because of the happy news at home—the already lavish dinner table was now piled with even more side dishes.</p><p>“Oh, right. I’m going to Jeju in two weeks. The Association told me to wrap up one more job, so I’ll be gone for a few days.”</p><p>“Jeju?”</p><p>At the mention of Jeju, Yoon Na-hyeon gave me a seductive smile.</p><p>“Yeah. I’ll know better once I get there, but I think it’ll take about three days.”</p><p>Recently, a large number of C and D-rank Gates had appeared in Jeju.</p><p>At first, the Association had sent C and D-rank Hunters to handle them, but progress was slower than expected, so they started dispatching A and B-rank Hunters to clear the Gates quickly.</p><p>The Association had given me a request: solo exploration of a single C-rank Gate.</p><p>‘Solo exploration of a C-rank Gate… They’re basically treating me like an A-rank Hunter now.’</p><p>Just then, Yoon Na-hyeon tapped the table and said,</p><p>“Let’s all go to Jeju!”</p><p>“I’m in. Now that the college entrance exams are over, I should go have some fun.”</p><p>“Jeju? Hmm… I guess the timing works out…”</p><p>The three women stared at me intently.</p><p>‘What’s this about…?’</p><p>Lately, this kind of thing happened a lot at home. Whenever we had to make a decision together, they always left the final say to me.</p><p>It seemed like I was now officially treated as the pillar and head of this household.</p><p>“Hmm… I guess it’s fine? If I account for the time it’ll take to handle the job, you could come three days after I leave and the timing should work out…”</p><p>“Really? Then I’ll book the accommodations.”</p><p>Seong Yu-na said with a smile.</p><p>“No, I’ll do it.”</p><p>I waved my hand to stop her. Lately, whenever we went to a hotel or out to eat, Seong Yu-na and Yoon Na-hyeon were the ones paying.</p><p>Even when I tried to spend my own money, they forcibly stopped me.</p><p>At this rate, I’d die without ever getting to use this money.</p><p>“How many nights are we staying?”</p><p>“Hmm, three nights, four days? It’s cold out, so we can take our time sightseeing in Jeju.”</p><p>“Got it. I’ll book the lodging and a rental car.”</p><p>“Where are you thinking?”</p><p>Seong Yu-na asked, looking a little worried.</p><p>“Huh? I was just going to book a nice resort…”</p><p>“A resort?”</p><p>All three of them looked pretty surprised.</p><p>“Yeah… For a family of four, wouldn’t a resort be the best?”</p><p>Anyway, the fee for this solo C-rank Gate exploration was 20 million won, with additional incentives paid separately.</p><p>‘Just think of it as spending all 20 million won…’</p><p>***</p><p>“They should be here soon…”</p><p>I park the car in front of the airport and wait for my family.</p><p>The solo exploration of the C-rank Gate ended in just two days. The Gate was smaller than expected, and the monsters inside were average in strength, so it wrapped up quickly.</p><p>“Hey, Seong-hyeon~.”</p><p>From a distance, the glass doors slide open, and Na-hyeon waves at me cheerfully. Behind her, Yu-na and Ji-hyeon follow along.</p><p>“Yeah, over here.”</p><p>We load the luggage into the rental car and head straight to the resort.</p><p>“Aren’t you hungry?”</p><p>“Starving… Let’s unpack first, then go eat right away.”</p><p>“Got it.”</p><p>Yu-na gazes out the window, admiring Jeju Island’s scenery, while Ji-hyeon keeps snapping photos nonstop.</p><p>“By the way, where’d you book the resort?”</p><p>“Hmm? We’re almost there. You’ll see when we get there.”</p><p>I’m secretly looking forward to their shocked reactions.</p><p>Because the resort I booked costs a whopping 1.9 million won per night. I searched through countless options, but this place had the best reviews and looked the most appealing in photos.</p><p>‘Damn, even if I burn 5.7 million won for three nights, the money I made in Jeju is way more…’</p><p>As the resort comes into view, Yu-na speaks in a trembling voice.</p><p>“W-ait, Seong-hyeon, is it… that place?”</p><p>“Yeah. After summer ends, they have hot springs and open-air baths, so we can go swimming too.”</p><p>“That’s why you told us to bring swimsuits.”</p><p>“Isn’t this place super expensive?”</p><p>Yu-na is stunned by the extravagant resort that looks absurdly pricey at first glance, while Na-hyeon and Ji-hyeon are busy taking pictures.</p><p>“Yeah… This is where we’re staying.”</p><p>True to its luxury status, the resort offers valet parking. We hand over the car and take the resort’s internal shuttle to our room.</p><p>The suite is 28 pyeong, with floors made of what seems to be marble or some other high-end stone. It’s furnished with all kinds of antique-style decor, a steam sauna room, and a large hinoki wood bathtub.</p><p>There are two bedrooms, and the living room is spacious enough for sleeping too, so accommodations won’t be an issue.</p><p>We won’t be able to have sex, but since this trip is meant to be a family vacation, it’s fine.</p><p>Honestly, I’ve been doing it so much lately that I think I can hold off for three nights and four days.</p><p>‘If I really can’t take it, I’ll just ask for a blowjob halfway through.’</p><p>“Wow…”</p><p>“Huh….”</p><p>“No way….”</p><p>I secretly puffed out my chest as I watched the three women marvel at the inside of the resort.</p><p>After unpacking at the resort, we went to a nearby place to eat black pork, and then we changed into swimsuits to enjoy the hot springs.</p><p>They told me to go ahead and save us some spots, so I came out first and was waiting for the three women.</p><p>“There aren’t many people here…. Nice.”</p><p>When I dipped my feet in the water, the temperature was just right for playing around in the cold weather—warm and cozy.</p><p>“Oh my, what is this… The pool is so beautiful.”</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290681" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Mom! Sister! The water is really warm!”</p><p>“Our little sister’s been through a lot….”</p><p>Just then, the three women arrived and dipped their feet in the water.</p><p>“Wow…. Did you three coordinate your outfits?”</p><p>“Yep, we each bought a cheap one since we were going out to have fun. How do we look?”</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290682" loading="lazy">
</p><p>Na-hyeon, who had been soaking her legs in the water, beamed as she walked over to me.</p><p>“T-…The best.”</p><p>Her violently erotic curves burst through the rash guard—so much that even the fabric couldn’t hide them.</p><p>I could feel the gazes of the men around us locking onto us.</p><p>A strange sense of superiority welled up inside me.</p><p>“Mom! Sister! Come in quick!”</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290683" loading="lazy">
</p><p>‘Damn, just looking at her is nice….’</p><p>I was definitely glad we came here.</p><p>***</p><p>After finishing our water activities, we returned to the resort, showered, and were about to go out for dinner, but everyone was so exhausted from playing in the water that we ended up eating at the buffet inside the resort. Then we came back and drank.</p><p>“Ji-hyeon, aren’t you drinking too much?”</p><p>“Now that the college entrance exams are over, I’m gonna drink every day~….”</p><p>Yoon Ji-hyeon chugged six cans of beer and started swaying.</p><p>‘She’s a lightweight….’</p><p>We were having a joyful, happy drinking session, sharing stories. It was definitely a happy moment, but there was one strange thing.</p><p>‘She’s sitting a little too close….’</p><p>Yoon Ji-hyeon had been clinging to me ever since she got drunk. And it wasn’t just clinging—she was pressing her body against me, rubbing up and down as if she were dizzy.</p><p>I could have brushed it off as her just having a certain type of drunk personality, but what was even stranger was that Yu-na and Na-hyeon were watching the whole thing with these little smirks on their faces.</p><p>A chill started creeping up my spine.</p><p>Memories from our last beach trip flashed through my mind.</p><p>‘No way…’</p><p>I looked down. Yoon Ji-hyeon had her eyes closed, rubbing her face against my arm.</p><p>When I glanced back up at Na-hyeon and Yu-na, they were both wearing the kind of sly, satisfied smiles you’d see on scientists watching an experiment go exactly as planned.</p><p>‘No, no… it can’t be.’</p><p>Unease settled over me. I chugged the last of my beer to shake it off.</p><p>***</p><p>We put the drunk Yoon Ji-hyeon to bed first, then the three of us had a few more drinks before calling it a night to prepare for the next day. Everyone went to wash up and head to sleep.</p><p>This room had one large twin-bed room and one single-bed room. The three of them took the big room, and I slept alone in the other.</p><p>It was the first time our whole family had gone on a trip together since I’d come back home, so it felt fresh, almost proud, in a way.</p><p>‘I should do this more often…’</p><p>Yu-na didn’t give me her usual nighttime oral service tonight, but maybe it was the alcohol or just the cozy mood—either way, I fell asleep quickly.</p><p>“Mmm…”</p><p>I had no idea how long I’d been out, but when I woke, the room was pitch black.</p><p>Something was touching me, running its hands over my body. My eyes snapped open.</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>I reached out and felt a waist, then the sensation of long hair brushing against my hand.</p><p>“Noona? When did you get here?”</p><p>“…”</p><p>Na-hyeon didn’t answer.</p><p>‘No way… did she sneak in because she couldn’t hold back?’</p><p>But the big room was right next door. If we made any noise in here, they’d definitely hear us.</p><p>“Then… maybe we should go somewhere else?”</p><p>A soft hand traced my abs, and my body heated up in response. In the end, I figured we could just go outside—it was dark, after all. We had a car. We could find some secluded spot nearby…</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>Wait. As I ran my hand over her waist, something felt… off.</p><p>The texture, the feel—it wasn’t quite like Na-hyeon’s.</p><p>“What?”</p>
